newsitem.title: USA: U.S. oil companies attended Iranian forum - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: U.S. oil companies attended Iranian forum - WSJ.

text.p: U.S. trade sanctions did not stop three American oil companies from attending an Iranian-sponsored energy conference this past weekend, the Wall Street Journal said.
In Monday's electronic edition, the Journal said that midlevel executives from Mobil Corp, Amoco Corp and DuPont Co's Conoco unit attended the conference in Iran.
Their appearance underscores the U.S. government's difficulty in its quest to isolate Iran's petroleum industry, the Journal said.
In case sanctions are lifted, U.S. companies are trying to maintain contact with Iranian companies, which have access to huge offshore oil and gas fields.
The Journal said that two executives who attended, representing Amoco's Overseas Petroleum Co and Mobil's Abu Dhabi Inc, declined to comment.

A Mobil spokesman said its executive was "there to listen and learn," and "update our database files." The spokesman said the trip "would have been cleared" with corporate officials to make sure it did not violate the spirit of the sanctions.
